market_question: Will Liverpool finish in the top 4 of the EPL 2025–26 standings?
reasoning: Liverpool is a consistently top-tier EPL side, finishing Top 4 in all but one of the last eight seasons. While competition for Top 4 is intense, their squad depth, managerial stability, and recent performance suggest a true probability significantly above the market's 52.5%. The gap of ~15.5% provides a clear edge.
evidence_points: Liverpool has achieved Top 4 in 7 of the last 8 EPL seasons (only miss in 2022-23).
Strong squad with world-class talent and depth, likely to compete for league honours.
Stable managerial setup under Arne Slot, who maintained high performance after Klopp's departure.
